purpose: Restarts and crashes the session on a real Mac and checks that the Claude app on the Mac and on the phone lists it again within two minutes. Takes the target host as a parameter.
title: Session restart and crash recovery on a real Mac and phone

testCases.description: On a target Mac: after a restart and a crash one registered and connected Squire session is back within two minutes, and a wake-up fired at it arrives.
testCases.testPointer: tests/e2e/round-2-session.test.js::the session restarted and then crashed is back within two minutes each time as exactly one registered and connected Squire session, and a wake-up fired at it arrives
